\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 273-276 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:LA-R280-first-pass-words-from-chapters-273-276}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a ditch and a rampart.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a wedding, a husband or wife, a parent, a grandson, a granddaughter
  \item leisure, business, profit, loss, a debt
  \item silk, mud, dust, smoke, ash
  \item a wasp, a gnat, a flea, a worm, a tortoise
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A wedding? (\textbf{nūptiae, nūptiārum}.) A husband or wife? (\textbf{coniūnx, coniugis}.) A parent? (\textbf{parēns, parentis}.) A grandson? (\textbf{nepōs, nepōtis}.) A granddaughter? (\textbf{neptis, neptis}.) Leisure? (\textbf{ōtium, ōtiī}.) Business? (\textbf{negōtium, negōtiī}.) Profit? (\textbf{lucrum, lucrī}.) Loss? (\textbf{damnum, damnī}.) A debt? (\textbf{dēbitum, dēbitī}.) Silk? (\textbf{sēricum, sēricī}.) Mud? (\textbf{lutum, lutī}.) Dust? (\textbf{pulvis, pulveris}.) Smoke? (\textbf{fūmus, fūmī}.) Ash? (\textbf{cinis, cineris}.) A wasp? (\textbf{vespa, vespae}.) A gnat? (\textbf{culex, culicis}.) A flea? (\textbf{pūlex, pūlicis}.) A worm? (\textbf{vermis, vermis}.) A tortoise? (\textbf{testūdō, testūdinis}.)
\end{tcolorbox}

  \item a tower, a column, city walls, a ditch, a rampart

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A helmet? (\textbf{galea, galeae}.) A spear? (\textbf{hasta, hastae}.) A bow; an arch? (\textbf{arcus, arcūs}.) An arrow? (\textbf{sagitta, sagittae}.) A trumpet? (\textbf{tuba, tubae}.) A book-roll? (\textbf{volūmen, volūminis}.) A page? (\textbf{pāgina, pāginae}.) A letter of the alphabet? (\textbf{littera, litterae}.) A word? (\textbf{verbum, verbī}.) A name? (\textbf{nōmen, nōminis}.) A cherry? (\textbf{cerasum, cerasī}.) A plum? (\textbf{prūnum, prūnī}.) Cabbage? (\textbf{brassica, brassicae}.) A leek? (\textbf{porrum, porrī}.) Porridge? (\textbf{puls, pultis}.) A tower? (\textbf{turris, turris}.) A column? (\textbf{columna, columnae}.) City walls? (\textbf{moenia, moenium}.) A ditch? (\textbf{fossa, fossae}.) A rampart? (\textbf{vallum, vallī}.)
